sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Atul Kumar Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Vikas Sharma
Hon'ble Karunesh Singh Pawar,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned counsel for respondent no.3 and 4 and learned A.G.A. for respondent State.

The present application has been filed by the applicants for quashing of the criminal proceedings arising out of Case No.2411 of 2019 under Sections 498A IPC, 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Madhauganj, District Hardoi pending before learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Hardoi.
Learned counsel for the applicants submits that dispute between the parties have been amicably settled outside the court by way of compromise.

The original copy of the compromise deed dated Chandresh @ Rajan And Others vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. ... on 15 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/13276408/
1 13.3.2024 is on record as Annexure-7 to the application.

entities.text: Chandresh @ Rajan And Others vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel appearing for respondent no.3 and 4 does not dispute the above facts rather he concedes the same.
It is jointly prayed by the parties' counsel that on the basis of compromise the proceedings impugned are liable to be quashed.
Learned A.G.A. has no objection, however, he submits that it will be appropriate that compromise is verified first by the competent court and only then any further orders may be passed.

On due consideration of the arguments advanced by the parties' counsel and perusal of the record and considering the law laid down by Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in the case of Gian Singh vs.
State of Punjab, 2012 AIR SCW 5333

entities.text:

State of Punjab, 2012 AIR SCW 5333

sentences.text: , the petition is disposed of directing the parties to appear before the learned trial court on 07.05.2024 for verification of the compromise dated.
Learned trial court shall verify the contents of the compromise in the presence of parties within a period of one week thereafter and provide a copy of verification report to the parties.
The proceedings impugned (supra) shall be kept in abeyance for the period of three months from today.

It will be open for the applicants to approach this Court again for quashing of the proceedings by filing a fresh petition along with verification report given by the learned trial court and also the compromise entered between the parties.
Original/certified copies of the documents filed along with the application shall be returned to the learned counsel for the applicant.
